groups.saying_opens: كنت أخدم النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

notes: «قال عباس حدثنا يحيى بن الوليد» gives another transmitter (Abbas, Yahya without Ibn Mahdi) after the same saying with no matn of its own: a remark, so variant and never a route
«- المعنى -» is an editor's gloss on the two co-transmitters; «قال أبو داود وهو أبو الزعراء» is an identification gloss by the compiler, left out (rule 9)
Saying 2 («قال هارون بن تميم عن الحسن قال الأبوال كلها سواء») is a second saying with its own transmitters: its own group (rule 4a)
